e.body:
**Aegis Insurance Decisioning Platform**（GitLab `backendlabs/Aegis-Insurance-Decision-Platform`）**是一个**把**「**决策留痕」**列**为**独立**模块**的**保险**决策**平台****——**逐字自述**为**「**a full-stack insurance decisioning system built for policy servicing, premium calculation, claim intake, risk evaluation, renewal workflows, and decision auditability**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**非 **GitHub** 的**代码**托管面**」**。
**可核实信息（均 2026-09-23 GitLab 接口实测）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它**把**「**决策**留痕」**与**「**管理**工作台」**写**成**独**立**模块**，**而**不**是**理赔**流程**的**附**属**项****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README** 逐字**列**出 **`Core Modules`** 九**项**（**含 **`Claim Risk Triage Engine`（**理赔**风险**分诊**引擎）**、**`Premium Rating Engine`（**保费**计**算**引擎）**、**`Decision Audit Trail`（**决策**留痕）**、**`Admin Decision Workbench`（**管理**决策**工作台）** 与 **`Customer, Agent, and Admin Role-Based UI`）**，**并**逐字**说明**管理**侧**「**review claims using a rule-based risk decisioning engine**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**对 **RIAA** 最有用**：**⭐ 即**保险**系统**里**「**决定」**往往**散**落**在**各**流程**的**日志**里**，**而**这**里**把**它**当**成**一**个**有**自己**生**命**周期**的**对象**（**谁**、**何时**、**依**据**哪条**规则、**结**果**如何**、**可**否**复**核）**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**做**核保**、**理赔**或**定价**系统**设计**时**，**先**画出**「**决策**记录」**这**张**表**，**再**画**业务**流程**（**⭐ 与**第 **379** 轮**记下的**「**只**追加**的**测试**触达**台账」**、**第 **380** 轮**「**80** 个**校验**才**算**交付」**同**属**「**把**可**审计**性**当**交付**物」**一**脉）**。
**⭐⭐ ② 它**的**模块**划分**可**以**当**成**通用的**最小**骨架****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README** 逐字**列**出 **`Policy Management`**、**`Insurance Plan Discovery`**、**`Claim Intake Workflow`**、**`Claim Risk Triage Engine`**、**`Premium Rating Engine`**、**`Renewal Reminder Workflow`**、**`Decision Audit Trail`**、**`Admin Decision Workbench`** 与**三**种**角色**的 **UI****；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**这**九**项**覆盖**了**「**保单**存续**期**管理**＋**理赔**受理**与**分诊**＋**定价**＋**续保**＋**审计」**的**完整**闭环**，**且**与**寿险**或**产险**都**不**冲突**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**写**系统**设计**文档**时**，**这**是**一**份**可**对照**的**清**单**（**⭐ 本词条**不**评价**其**实现**质量**）**。
**⭐⭐ ③ ⚠️⭐ 它**给出**了**一**条**可**复用**的**许可**判据**（**接口**字段**空 ≠ **无**许可）****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**GitLab** 项目**接口**返回的 **`license`** 字段**为**空**（**即**平台**未**识**别**出**许可）**，**而**仓库**根**目录**的 **`LICENSE`** 文件**逐字**起**首**为 **`MIT License`** 与 **`Copyright (c) 2026 Aegis Insurance Decisioning Platform`****，**README** 徽章**亦逐字**为 **`License-MIT`****；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**平台**的**许可**识别**失败」**与**「**作**品**没有**许可」**在**接口**输出**上**都**是**空**，**二**者**无**法**从**字段**区分**——**⭐ 故**判**许可**必须**读**仓库**内**的**许可**文件**（**⭐ 与**第 **380** 轮**记下的**「**Zenodo** 存档**许可**字段**拼写**错误 **`apgl-v3`」**同**属**「**元数据**字段**不**可**全**信」**一**类，**而**本**轮**这**一**条**是**反**方向：**字段**空**但**实际**有**许可**）**。
**⭐⭐ ④ 它**自陈**为**「**模拟**真实**保险**运营**平台」**，**故**应**按**参考**架构**评价****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README** 逐字**写**「**This project simulates a real-world insurance operations platform where customers can view policies, submit claims, calculate premiums, track renewals, and where admin users can review claims using a rule-based risk decisioning engine.**」**，**并**逐字**声明**其**重点**为**「**backend design, business rule execution, clean API contracts, maintainable code structure, and production-ready engineering practices**」**；**⭐ 本词条**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**模**拟**真实**运营」**这**句**话**既**是**定位**也**是**边界**——**⭐ 它**不**是**生产**系统**，**其**数据**与**规则**都**是**示**例**级**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**引用**这**类**项目**时**，**写**明**「**它**是**教学**与**参考**架构」**，**而**不**要**把**其**模**块**清单**当**成**行业**标准**。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 技**术**栈**与**交付**形态****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README** 徽章**逐字**为 **Java 17／**Spring Boot 3.2／**Angular 18／**TypeScript 5.x／**Docker-Ready／**License-MIT****；**顶层**目录**逐字 **14** 项**，**含 **`aegis-decisioning-api`（**后端**）、**`aegis-decisioning-portal`（**前端**）、**`docs`**、**`postman`（**接口**集合**）、**`scripts`**、**`docker-compose.yml`**、**`SECURITY.md`** 与 **`CONTRIBUTING.md`****；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**API** 与 **UI** 分**仓**内**双目录**＋**接口**集合**＋**一**键**编排**文件」**是**一**种**可**直接**借**用**的**交付**形态**（**⭐ 有**了 **postman** 集合**，**读**者**不**必**先**搭**起**前端**就**能**试**接**口）**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[titanium-insurance-core]] 覆盖**保险**核心**系统**、**[[socotra]] 覆盖**保单**管理**平台**、**[[guidewire-mcp]] 覆盖**保险**软件的 **MCP** 接口**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**把**决策**留痕**列**为**独立**模块**、**并**以**规则**引擎**做**理赔**分诊」这一**形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。
**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **把**决策**记录**当**独立**对象**设计**；**② **模块**清单**可**作**系统**设计**对照**；**③ **判**许可**要**读**仓库**文件**而**非**接口**字段**；**④ **引用**教学**型**项目**要**写**明**其**定位**；**⑤ **交**付**含**接口**集合**与**编排**文件**，**降**低**试**用**门槛**。
**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有克隆**其**仓库**、**未**构建**或**运行**其 **API** 与**前端**、**未**使用**其 **`docker-compose.yml`** 或 **postman** 集合**，**故**不**主张**其**可**运行**性**、**功能**完整性**或**代码**质量**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**GitLab** 项目**接口**、**仓库**顶层**目录**接口**、**`README.md`** 与 **`LICENSE`** 文件**，**未读**其**源码**、**测试**或**文档**目录**内容**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其 **9** 个**核心**模块**是否**都**已**实现**（**README** 列**出**不**等于**实**现）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**规则**引擎**的**规则**表示**方式**与**可**审计**粒度**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**是否**有**测试**或 **CI**（**⭐ 顶层**有 **`.github`** 目录，**但**本词条**未**读**其**内容**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ **★0** 与**创建**／**末次**活动**同日（**2026-09-16）**为 **2026-09-23** 快照**，**会**变化**。**⑦ ⚠️ 窗口**状况**：**末次**活动 **2026-09-16** 落在**本轮**窗口**之内**（**基准日 **2026-09-23）**，**故**无需**缺口**说明**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-23 所见**；**⚠️ 其**规则**与**定价**逻辑**为**示**例**性质**，**⚠️ 不**构成**任何**核保**、**定价**或**合规**意见**。

e.title_en: An insurance decisioning platform that lists decision auditability as a core module: it describes itself as a full-stack insurance decisioning system for policy servicing, premium calculation, claim intake, risk evaluation, renewal workflows, and decision auditability, names nine core modules including a claim risk triage engine, a premium rating engine, a decision audit trail, and a role-based interface for customers, agents, and administrators, and states that it simulates a real-world insurance operations platform; the hosting interface reports no licence while the licence file in the repository is MIT, so a missing licence field is not the absence of a licence.
e.title_hk: **一個**把**「**決策留痕」**列為獨立模塊的保險決策平台****：`aegis-insurance-decisioning-platform`——**⭐ 逐字自述**為**「**a full-stack insurance decisioning system built for policy servicing, premium calculation, claim intake, risk evaluation, renewal workflows, and decision auditability**」**；**⭐ 核心模塊逐字 9 項**（**含 Claim Risk Triage Engine、**Premium Rating Engine、**Decision Audit Trail 與 Customer, Agent, and Admin Role-Based UI）**；**⭐ 而它逐字自陳定位為**「**simulates a real-world insurance operations platform**」**；**⭐ **★0、**創建 2026-09-16**；**⚠️⭐ 其 GitLab 介面的許可字段為空**，**而倉庫內 `LICENSE` 文件逐字為 MIT**——**⭐ 即**介面沒報許可≠**沒有許可**
e.summary_en: This is an insurance decisioning platform that lists decision auditability as a core module, describing itself as a full-stack system for policy servicing, premium calculation, claim intake, risk evaluation, renewal workflows, and decision auditability. **Measured this round**: created and last active on the same day in mid-September inside the window, with no stars, and with an empty licence field in the hosting interface while the licence file in the repository reads as an MIT licence; the top level holds fourteen entries including separate API and portal directories, documentation, a postman collection, scripts, a compose file, a security policy, and contribution guidance; and the stated stack is a long-term-support Java release with a recent Spring Boot version and a recent Angular version, plus TypeScript and Docker support. **This round theme is the non-GitHub code hosting surface, since the earlier saturation judgements on this site were all made on one platform, and this round measures another.** **Four things are worth reading: it makes the decision audit trail and the admin decision workbench standalone modules rather than appendices to the claims flow, alongside a rule-based risk decision engine, which matters because who decided what under which rule is itself an object that has to be persisted, so audit should be a design goal rather than a later patch, and anyone writing underwriting or claims system coursework should draw the decision record as a table first; its module split is a reasonable minimum skeleton shared by life and non-life operations, covering policy management, product discovery, claim intake, risk triage, premium rating, renewal reminders, decision audit, an administrative workbench, and a role-based interface; it supplies a reusable licence criterion, since the hosting interface reports no licence while the licence file in the repository root is an MIT licence with a copyright line, so a failed licence detection and an absent licence look identical in interface output, and licences must be read from repository files rather than interface fields; and it describes itself as simulating a real-world insurance operations platform, so it should be assessed as a teaching and reference architecture rather than a production system.** **Nothing was cloned, built, or launched through its compose file this round.**

This is an insurance decisioning platform that lists decision auditability as a core module. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the non-GitHub code hosting surface.**
**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-23 from the hosting interface**:
**First, it makes the decision audit trail and the admin decision workbench standalone modules rather than appendices to the claims flow.** The readme lists nine core modules including a claim risk triage engine, a premium rating engine, a decision audit trail, an admin decision workbench, and a role-based interface for customers, agents, and administrators, and states that administrative users review claims using a rule-based risk decisioning engine. **In insurance systems the decision itself often lives scattered across process logs, whereas here it becomes an object with its own lifecycle, namely who decided, when, under which rule, with what outcome, and whether it can be reviewed afterwards, so system design coursework should draw the decision record table before drawing the process, in the same family as the append-only ledger and the all-checks-must-pass delivery gate recorded in earlier rounds.**
**Second, its module split works as a minimum skeleton.** The nine modules cover policy management, product discovery, claim intake, claim risk triage, premium rating, renewal reminders, decision audit, an administrative workbench, and three role-based interfaces, which together form a closed loop of policy administration, claims intake and triage, pricing, renewal, and audit that fits both life and non-life operations, and the list is worth using as a checklist when writing a design document, though this entry makes no judgement about implementation quality.**
**Third, it supplies a reusable licence criterion, since an empty interface field is not the absence of a licence.** The hosting interface returns an empty licence field while the licence file in the repository root opens with an MIT licence and a copyright line, and the readme badge also reads as MIT. **A platform failing to detect a licence and an artefact having no licence both appear as an empty field, so they cannot be told apart from the field, and licences must be read from repository files. This is the mirror image of the earlier case where an archive licence field contained a misspelling, and both belong to the rule that metadata fields cannot be fully trusted.**
**Fourth, it describes itself as simulating a real-world insurance operations platform, so it should be assessed as a reference architecture.** The readme says the project simulates a platform where customers view policies, submit claims, calculate premiums, and track renewals while administrators review claims through a rule-based engine, and states that its focus is backend design, business rule execution, clean API contracts, maintainable structure, and production-ready engineering practices. **That sentence is both a positioning and a boundary: it is not a production system and its data and rules are illustrative, so citing such a project should say it is teaching and reference material rather than treating its module list as an industry standard.**
**Fifth, stack and delivery shape.** The badges name a long-term-support Java release, a recent Spring Boot version, a recent Angular version, TypeScript, Docker readiness, and the MIT licence; the top level holds fourteen entries including separate API and portal directories, documentation, a postman collection, scripts, a compose file, a security policy, and contribution guidance. **Shipping an interface collection with a one-command orchestration file lowers the barrier to trying it out, since a reader can exercise the API without standing up the front end first.**
**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover an insurance core system, a policy administration platform, and an MCP interface for insurance software, **while this entry supplies the form of a platform that treats decision audit as a first-class module and triages claims with a rule engine. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**
**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: design the decision record as its own object; use a module list as a design checklist; read licences from repository files rather than interface fields; state the teaching positioning when citing a demonstration project; and ship an interface collection with orchestration to lower the trial barrier.**
**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the repository was not cloned, neither the API nor the front end was built or run, and neither the compose file nor the postman collection was used**, so no claim is made about runnability, feature completeness, or code quality. **Second, only the project interface, the top-level tree interface, the readme, and the licence file were read**, not the source, tests, or documentation contents. **Third, whether all nine core modules are implemented was not verified**, since listing them in a readme is not the same as implementing them. **Fourth, the rule representation and audit granularity of the decision engine were not verified. Fifth, whether tests or continuous integration exist was not verified**, a workflows directory being present at the top level without its contents being read. **Sixth, the star count and the creation and last activity dates are a snapshot from the twenty-third of September and will change. Seventh, the last activity falls inside this round window against that baseline. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on that date and states plainly that its rules and pricing logic are illustrative and constitute no underwriting, pricing, or compliance opinion.**

**Aegis Insurance Decisioning Platform**（GitLab `backendlabs/Aegis-Insurance-Decision-Platform`）**是一個**把**「**決策留痕」**列為獨立模塊的保險決策平台****——**逐字自述**為**「**a full-stack insurance decisioning system built for policy servicing, premium calculation, claim intake, risk evaluation, renewal workflows, and decision auditability**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**非 GitHub 的代碼託管面**」**。
**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-23 GitLab 介面實測）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 把決策留痕與管理工作台寫成獨立模塊**——**逐字含 Claim Risk Triage Engine、**Premium Rating Engine、**Decision Audit Trail、**Admin Decision Workbench 與 Customer, Agent, and Admin Role-Based UI**，**並逐字說明管理側**review claims using a rule-based risk decisioning engine**；**⭐ 即**保險系統裡「**決定」**常散落在流程日誌中**，**這裡把「**誰、**何時、**依據哪條規則、**結果、**可否複核」**當成獨立對象**（**與第 379 輪「**只追加的測試觸達台賬」**同屬「**把可審計性當交付物」**）**。
**⭐⭐ ② 模塊劃分可當通用最小骨架**——**九項覆蓋保單存續期、**理賠受理與分診、**定價、**續保與**審計閉環**，**壽險產險都不衝突**。
**⭐⭐ ③ ⚠️⭐ 許可判據：介面字段空 ≠ 無許可**——**GitLab 項目介面 license 字段為空**，**而倉庫根目錄 LICENSE 文件逐字起首為 MIT License 與 Copyright (c) 2026 Aegis Insurance Decisioning Platform**，**README 徽章亦逐字 License-MIT**；**⭐ 即**平台識別失敗與作品沒有許可，在介面輸出上都是空**，**故必須讀倉庫內文件**（**與第 380 輪 apgl-v3 拼寫錯誤同屬「**元資料字段不可全信」**，**而本輪是反方向**）**。
**⭐⭐ ④ 自陳為模擬真實保險運營平台，應按參考架構評價**——**逐字**This project simulates a real-world insurance operations platform where customers can view policies, submit claims, calculate premiums, track renewals, and where admin users review claims using a rule-based risk decisioning engine.** 與 **backend design, business rule execution, clean API contracts, maintainable code structure, and production-ready engineering practices.**；**⭐ 即**教學與參考架構**，**其數據與規則皆為示例級**。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 技術棧與交付形態**——**徽章逐字 Java 17／**Spring Boot 3.2／**Angular 18／**TypeScript 5.x／**Docker-Ready／**License-MIT**；**頂層目錄逐字 14 項**，**含 api／**portal／**docs／**postman／**scripts／**docker-compose.yml／**SECURITY.md／**CONTRIBUTING.md**；**⭐ 即**雙目錄＋**接口集合＋**一鍵編排是可借用形態**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[titanium-insurance-core]]、[[socotra]]、[[guidewire-mcp]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**把決策留痕列為獨立模塊、**並以規則引擎做理賠分診」**這一形態**。
**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **決策記錄當獨立對象**；**② **模塊清單作對照**；**③ **讀倉庫文件判許可**；**④ **寫明教學定位**；**⑤ **交付帶接口集合與編排文件**。
**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有克隆倉庫、**未構建或**運行其 API 與前端、**未使用其 docker-compose 或 postman 集合**，**不主張其可運行性、**功能完整性或**代碼質量**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀 GitLab 介面、**頂層目錄介面、**README.md 與 LICENSE 文件**，**未讀源碼、**測試或**文檔目錄內容**。**③ ⚠️ **未核實**九個核心模塊是否都已實現**。**④ ⚠️ **未核實**其規則引擎的規則表示方式與可審計粒度**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核實**其是否有測試或 CI**。**⑥ ⚠️ **★0 與創建／**末次活動同日（2026-09-16）為 2026-09-23 快照**。**⑦ ⚠️ 窗口狀況：**末次活動 2026-09-16 在本輪窗口之內（**基準日 2026-09-23）**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-23 所見**；**⚠️ 其規則與定價邏輯為示例性質**，**⚠️ 不構成任何核保、**定價或**合規意見**。
